st: The Night Of The Iron Fist
d: West and Gordon battle an assortment of characters to extradite a Bosnian Nobleman back to his homeland to face trial.

st: The Night Of The Running Death
d: Secret agents James West and Artemus Gordon join a wagon train of entertainers in their search for a mysterious assassin.
An over-ambitious general plans to rise to the presidency of the U.S. because of his reputation as a ruthless Indian fighter.

st: The Night Of The Headless Woman
d: Secret agents West and Gordon work to avert the destruction of the American Cotton industry.
Agents West and Gordon struggle to bring to justice a weirdly garbed, artillery-equipped gang of bank robbers.

st: The Night Of The Underground Terror
d: Former inmates of a Civil War prison camp seek revenge against the camp commandant because of his alleged atrocities against them.

st: The Night Of The Death Masks
d: A murderer trapped by agent James T. West breaks out of prison with a bizarre plan to assassinate him.
Secret agent West is attacked while guarding a precious cargo of smallpox vaccine and loses his memory from a blow on the head.
Agents West and Gordon encounter voodoo rites and a diabolical biologist and his throng of robot-like slaves.
Secret agents West and Gordon face a killer beast and a mystery guarded by a senator and his three sons.
A would-be dictator's attempt to assassinate President Ulysses S. Grant brings him up against secret agents West and Gordon.

st: The Night Of The Big Blackmail
d: A double-dealing foreign diplomat attempts to implicate the United States in an international conspiracy.

st: The Night Of The Doomsday Formula
d: Agents West and Gordon are determined to foil an ex-army general's plan to gain possession of a secret explosive formula.
A man uses a steam-driven juggernaut to drive off homesteaders so he can appropriate their oil-rich land.

st: The Night Of The Sedgewick Curse
d: Agents West and Gordon come across a physician plying a wealthy family with a drug that causes rapid aging.

st: The Night Of The Gruesome Games
d: Agents West and Gordon, searching for a powerful germ culture, invade the mansion of an eccentric millionaire.
A strange sea monster preying on Portuguese fishermen and their boats becomes the object of an investigation by agents West and Gordon.
